paite: Huan angel nganain a mutta a, huan van akipan aksi leitunga kesa ka mu a; huan amah kiangah guamkhuk thukpi honna tahbi piakin a oma.
english: The fifth angel sounded, and I saw a star from the sky which had fallen to the earth. The key to the pit of the abyss was given to him.

paite: Huan amah guam khuk thukpi tuh a hongta a; huan huai guam akipanin meikhu, meipi khu bangmai a pawt touta a huai guama meikhu jiakin ni leh huihkhua hihmialin a omta hi.
english: He opened the pit of the abyss, and smoke went up out of the pit, like the smoke from a TR adds “great” burning furnace. The sun and the air were darkened because of the smoke from the pit.

paite: Huan meikhu a kipanin khaupe leitung ah a hong suakta a; leia aikamten thil hihtheihna a nei bangin, amau tuh thilhihtheihna piakin a omta ua.
english: Then out of the smoke came forth locusts on the earth, and power was given to them, as the scorpions of the earth have power.

paite: Huan amau tuh leitunga loupate bang, thil hing himhim bang, sing peuhmah leng, hihse loua, mi kuapeuh a tal ua Pathian chiamtehna neiloute kia hihse dia hilhin a om ua.
english: They were told that they should not hurt the grass of the earth, neither any green thing, neither any tree, but only those people who don’t have God’s seal on their foreheads.

paite: Huan amau that lou dinga, kha nga amau hih genthei zo dinga hilhin a om ua; huan a hihgentheihna uh tuh aikamin mi a teha, gentheihna bangmai ahi.
english: They were given power not to kill them, but to torment them for five months. Their torment was like the torment of a scorpion, when it strikes a person.

paite: Huan huai ni chiangin min sihna a zong ding ua, huan bangchi mah a mu kei ding uh; huan sih a ut ding ua, himahleh sihnain amau a taimang san ding.
english: In those days people will seek death, and will in no way find it. They will desire to die, and death will flee from them.

paite: Huan huai khaupete mel tuh sakol kodounaa pang dia bawl bangmai ahi ua; huan a lu tunguah lallukhu hileh kilawm dangkaeng bangtak a oma, huan a mai uh mihingte mai bangmai ahi.
english: The shapes of the locusts were like horses prepared for war. On their heads were something like golden crowns, and their faces were like people’s faces.

paite: Huan numei sam bangtak sam a nei ua, a ha uh humpinelkai ha bangmai ahi.
english: They had hair like women’s hair, and their teeth were like those of lions.

paite: Huan awmphaw, sik awmphaw hileh kilawm a nei ua; huan a kha jap ging uh kidouna lama sakol tampi tai dupdup, kidouna kangtalai tampi ging bangmai ahi.
english: They had breastplates, like breastplates of iron. The sound of their wings was like the sound of chariots, or of many horses rushing to war.

paite: Huan aikam bangmai mei a nei ua, gu leng; huan a mei uah a thilhihtheihna uh, mihingte kha nga hihnatna ding a oma.
english: They have tails like those of scorpions, and stings. In their tails they have power to harm men for five months.

paite: Guam khukthukpi angel tuh a tung ua kumpipa-in a nei ua: Hebru pauin a min tuh Abaddon ahi a, huan Grik pauin a min tuh Appolion ahi.
english: They have over them as king the angel of the abyss. His name in Hebrew is “Abaddon,” “Abaddon” is a Hebrew word that means ruin, destruction, or the place of destruction but in Greek, he has the name “Apollyon.” “Apollyon” means “Destroyer.”

paite: Tunggikna masapen tuh a beita a ngaiin, tunggikna nih tunung chiangin a hongtung nalai ding hi.
english: The first woe is past. Behold, there are still two woes coming after this.

paite: Huan angel guknain a mutta a, huan Pathian maa om dangkaeng mitam ki akipanin aw ka zata a
english: The sixth angel sounded. I heard a voice from the horns of the golden altar which is before God,

paite: Huai awin tuh angel gukna pengkul nei kiangah, Luipi Euphratisa angel li hena omte phel in, a chi a.
english: saying to the sixth angel who had one trumpet, “Free the four angels who are bound at the great river Euphrates!”

paite: Huan, angel lite tuh phelin a omta ua, amau tuh mi mun thuma khen mun khat a thah theihna ding un, dak khat leh ni khat leh kha khat leh kumkhat kisain, a na omta ua.
english: The four angels were freed who had been prepared for that hour and day and month and year, so that they might kill one third of mankind.

paite: Huan huai sakol tungtuang mi sepaih tam lam tuh sing ngen mun sing nih ahi: a tam uh kigen ka ja a.
english: The number of the armies of the horsemen was two hundred million literally, “ten thousands of ten thousands” . I heard the number of them.

paite: Huan huchibangin kilaknain sakolte leh a tung ua tuangte, mei banga san, engdup leh kat banga eng, awmphaw neite tuh ka muta a: huan sakolte lu tuh humpinelkai lu bangmai ahi ua; huan a kam ua kipanin mei leh meikhu leh kat a suak khe ta a.
english: Thus I saw the horses in the vision, and those who sat on them, having breastplates of fiery red, hyacinth blue, and sulfur yellow; and the heads of lions. Out of their mouths proceed fire, smoke, and sulfur.

paite: Huan hi thumte mei leh meikhu leh kat, a kam ua kipana hongpawt khiain mi munthuma khen mun khat tuh thahin a omta ua.
english: By these three plagues were one third of mankind killed: by the fire, the smoke, and the sulfur, which proceeded out of their mouths.

paite: Huai sakolte thilhihtheihna tuh a kam ua leh a mei ua om ahi ngala; a mei khawng uh tuh gulpi toh a kibang ua, lu leng a nei uhi; huan huaitein mi a hihna uhi.
english: For the power of the horses is in their mouths, and in their tails. For their tails are like serpents, and have heads, and with them they harm.

paite: Huan midang huai gawtnaa siloute, dawite, dangkaengte milimte, dangka milimte, suang milimte, leh sing milimte; huai amau muhjtheihna neiloute, be nawn lou dingin a khut ua a nasep khiakte uah tuh a kidik kei uhi;Huan a tualthahna uah leh a mibumna uah leh a kingaihna khelhna uah leh a guktakna uah tuh a kisik tuan kei uhi.
english: The rest of mankind, who were not killed with these plagues, didn’t repent of the works of their hands, that they wouldn’t worship demons, and the idols of gold, and of silver, and of brass, and of stone, and of wood; which can neither see, nor hear, nor walk.

paite: Huan a tualthahna uah leh a mibumna uah leh a kingaihna khelhna uah leh a guktakna uah tuh a kisik tuan kei uhi.
english: They didn’t repent of their murders, nor of their sorceries, The word for “sorceries” (pharmakeia) also implies the use of potions, poisons, and drugs nor of their sexual immorality, nor of their thefts.
